channel.title: HxGN TV – HxGN Spotlight
channel.description: Hexagon’s platform for original stories from opinion leaders and customers

item.title: Hexagon’s News Mash-Up
item.dc:creator: Zach Riggs
item.description: Hexagon's fourth quarter of 2022 was packed with new acquisitions and partnerships, exciting innovations, movement in sustainability across the world and a new CEO!

item.title: Tales of the surveyor: Experiencing the evolution of surveying technology from 1974-2023
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this new series from Leica Geosystems, we are bringing surveyors into the spotlight we know they deserve, as the true significance of surveying is best understood through their stories and experiences.

item.title: Tech Highlight: AiMaps
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN TV, we’re discussing AiMaps, the new software tool from IDS GeoRadar for IQMaps, offering intelligent cloud processing of GPR data for a faster detection of underground utilities.

item.title: Exact Metrology and Hexagon: A decades-long partnership
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN TV, we sat down with Dean Solberg, VP of Exact Metrology, who discusses their decades-long partnership with Hexagon, how the relationship has evolved, exciting innovations in the manufacturing market space and the value of working cooperatively with an equipment manufacturer.

item.title: Hexagon | NovAtel tests to the edge
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: We loaded our SPAN technology into a L-39 Albatros high-performance jet and put it through extreme acrobatic manoeuvres at over 500 miles per hour pulling over 5 G's. Even in these extreme difficult conditions, SPAN technology from NovAtel delivers.

item.title: Hexagon’s News Mash-Up (November 2022)
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: A Hexagon product named one of TIME Magazine’s Best Inventions of 2022, a smart city in Brazil, clean energy in Austria, a new global website and more. Don’t miss the latest edition of Hexagon's News Mash-Up.

item.title: Integrating Smart Digital Reality for operations and maintenance within buildings
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN TV, learn how Hexagon reality capture technologies can support Hexagon's EAM solution to advance operations and maintenance excellence.

item.title: Introducing a unique life of mine experience
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN TV, we dive deep into Hexagon’s Life-of-Mine Experience - an interactive, digital journey and the centerpiece of its educational efforts.

item.title: Enabling the future of work for manufacturing
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Ales Holeček, VP Office, Microsoft, and Hexagon's Arno Zinke discuss how cloud technologies are enabling the future of work in manufacturing.

item.title: Successfully deploying integrated public safety solutions across DuPage County, IL
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In critical situations and medical emergencies, time is of the essence. But dispatching the right first responders to the right location can be tricky when multiple agencies use disparate and disconnected systems across an entire county.
